title: ward check runner protocol
description: ward POSTs a Request to the hook URL of a runner with the header Ward-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the exact body bytes under the shared secret>. A 2xx answer accepts the request. The runner later POSTs a Result to <ward>/v1/results with the header Authorization: Bearer <check token>. A check token is wd1.<base64url payload>.<base64url Ed25519 signature>, with the claims kid, scope=check, repo and exp. A pull runner dials out instead: it POSTs a LeaseRequest to <ward>/v1/runner/leases with a runner token (the same encoding, with the claims kid, scope=runner and exp), and ward holds the poll for up to 20 seconds, then answers 200 with a Lease or 204. The runner POSTs an empty JSON object to <ward>/v1/runner/leases/<lease_id>/renew about every third of ttl_seconds, and stops the check when ward answers 410. A lease that is not renewed ends, and ward leases the same request_id again. The result post is the same as for a push runner.

run.description: The argument vector. The runner runs it at the root of the tree.

commit.description: A commit of motte whose tree is tree.

check_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the compact JSON object of check, in the key order name, run, timeout_seconds, with no HTML escaping.

env.description: The env text of the runner entry. May be empty.

log_url.description: At most 2048 bytes. May be empty.

isolation.description: The sandbox that the runner uses for every check. ward answers 403 when it is weaker than the minimum of every repository that the runner serves.

ttl_seconds.description: The lease ends this long after the last renewal.
